The Kubernetes package manager

Usage:
  helm [command]

Available Commands:
  install       Install a chart
  uninstall     Uninstall a chart
  upgrade       Upgrade a chart
  list          List releases
  search        Search for charts
  repo          Manage chart repositories
  template      Render local chart templates
  lint          Check a chart for possible issues
  test          Run tests for a release
  version       Show the version of Helm

Flags:
  -h, --help                    help for helm
      --kubeconfig string       path to the kubeconfig file
  -n, --namespace string        namespace scope for the request
      --qps float                query per second for requests (default 50)

Use "helm [command] --help" for more information about a command.
